text:
I don't see anything in our policy about plant insurance or a loyalty points program, so I can't confirm we offer either. What we do have is the free **Plant Care Guarantee** (30 days from delivery, or 90 days for Leafy Plus members), which covers a free replacement if a plant dies or declines significantly despite reasonable care.

Leafy Plus ($59/year) is the closest thing to a membership perk program. It includes free Standard shipping, free change-of-mind returns, 10% off pots and accessories, and early access to rare plant drops. If you'd like to ask about insurance or points specifically, I can escalate your question.
